note: Small rustic campground on the east shore of Old Veteran's Lake in the Governor Earl Peshtigo River State Forest, on Parkway Road about 3.5 miles north of County X near Crivitz, with a small swimming beach and the Old Vet's Lake hiking loop. Generators are not allowed. The longest rig reported here is 21 ft; larger rigs are unproven on the narrow forest road. --Claude
summary: DNR camping page + 2024 map + FR-617 brochure read: 16 sites (14/15 double), no electric, vault toilets, potable water, dump/showers at Gov Thompson SP; reservation required, 14-night max, no generators; season Apr 27-end Nov (manual, matches the web page; 2024 brochure says April-December). Not waterfront kept (lake-side sites 11-16 ~30-60 m from the lake through woods). Pin in the campground. Rig-length caveat kept (no DNR length found; GTC unread).
